About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We're looking for a builder to help construct a world class Growth organization. This is an opinionated leader that is motivated by creating big picture vision and digging into where the biggest opportunities are, sizing them, and building the systems, rigor, and connective tissue that let Growth and GTM operate cohesively. This is a member of Gusto's Insights & Operations (I&O) team — our internal Strategy/BizOps function — embedded against Growth, partnering closely with our Head of Growth and our CRO-side GTM leadership.

This role is intentionally IC-first. You'll start by going deep on the highest-leverage problems in Growth, build a point of view grounded in data, and drive it to outcome. As trust and scope grow, this role is expected to expand — most likely into owning the operating bridge between Growth and our broader go-to-market organization, and potentially into building and leading a small team.

About the Team:

Gusto's Growth organization is on an ambitious trajectory: we're building toward a much more self-serve-led motion, and the opportunity ahead is significant. As Growth scales, we have a chance to be much more intentional about how it connects to Product and to our go-to-market teams (sales, demand gen, expansion sales, pricing, etc) — building a shared, prioritized roadmap and clear visibility into dependencies from the ground up, rather than retrofitting it later.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Identify and size the highest-leverage opportunities for Growth: go from a fuzzy problem to a clear-eyed analysis of the opportunity, a recommendation on whether to pursue it, and a plan if the answer is yes.
  • Anchor on problems, not headcount: dig into what's actually slowing the Growth organization down, define how to build a best in class engine, size the opportunity, and decide what's worth solving before proposing who or what is needed — not the reverse.
  • Build the operating rhythm for Growth and drive execution against it: planning cycles, prioritization, and a shared, prioritized roadmap that makes trade-offs and dependencies visible across Growth R&D, Product R&D, and GTM.
  • Bring real analytical rigor to how Growth invests — attribution, LTV, and testing/experimentation discipline — so decisions about where to deploy resources are tied clearly to business impact.
  • Close the gap between Growth R&D and go-to-market: build the mechanisms (shared roadmap, dependency tracking, decision forums) that let both orgs operate as one team working toward the same number, rather than two orgs trading requests.
  • Design an operating system anchored in technology vs. humans: build the muscle and mechanisms the Growth org can through automation, and hand off ownership once a system is running
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Growth leadership: pressure-test strategy, surface risks and blind spots early, and bring an opinionated point of view, not just facilitation.
  • Use AI as a default, not an add-on: build reusable, AI-powered workflows for planning, synthesis, and reporting so manual coordination is the exception, not the norm.
  • Spot when a team is optimizing for the wrong thing: recognize when more effort against the current approach won't get us where we need to go, and push teams toward a fundamentally different path rather than a marginal improvement.
  • Raise the bar for how I&O operates, not just how Growth operates: share what's working, question what isn't, and help the broader I&O team build a stronger, more consistent craft.

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 15+ years in operations, business operations, or strategy & ops at a high-growth tec

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success Enterprise
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our users are the heart of our business. Stripe’s Global Customer Success Team is responsible for managing our largest and most strategic relationships, such as Doordash, Lyft, and Shopify. In this manager role you’ll be responsible for a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers. You’ll lead and coach the team, helping them deliver on ambitious targets, roll up your sleeves to work directly with executives at existing enterprise Stripe customers and partner cross functionally to help users execute their business priorities.

We are looking for a hands-on, visionary leader who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, and solving complicated problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have management and leadership experience scaling a technology Customer Success team, superior communication skills, and a track record for building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and understanding unique customer needs.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a Manager to lead a team of high-performing Customer Success Managers to build and grow the relationships with our most complex users. You will:

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a team of Customer Success Managers supporting strategic, relationship-based accounts.
  • Help drive an engagement model focused on building durable user relationships, increasing adoption, delivering value
  • Develop both the vision and strategy for the team, driving progress toward customer health, renewal and growth metrics 
  • Be accountable for identifying risks and opportunities early, and helping the team build and work through mitigation plans.
  • Coach, mentor, and guide the team in developing consultative customer success and sales skills
  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe’s solutions to meet client needs
  • Build strong operating rhythms for the team, including account planning, health reviews, renewal forecasting and business reviews.
  • Inspire, motivate, and enable the team by setting clear expectations, providing direct feedback and supporting their individual development and career growth. 

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 12+ years of customer-facing experience in customer success, account management, or sales with 5 years of people management experience
  • Payments or Fintech experience and/or experience in a complex SaaS consumption environment 
  • Experience leading sales or account management in a high-growth technology environment
  • Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performing user-facing team
  • Ability to support the Customer Success Managers’ efforts through strategic advice on account strategies, and serving as executive sponsor with key relationships
  • Ability to operate in a high-growth environment and work through ambiguity to solve complex customer and business problems
  • Demonstrated passion for Stripe’s mission, and helping users succeed

Nice to haves:

  • Prior experience at a high-growth stage Internet/software company

About the Team

The Dasher & Logistics team supports the millions of Dashers who power DoorDash’s marketplace. We’re building the world’s leading last-mile logistics platform — and to succeed, we’ll need to disrupt ourselves along the way. The Dasher Financial team is one such disruption: we are building fintech products that best serve the needs of Dashers and gig workers like them.

From instant access to earnings, to innovative bill pay and savings products, to credit-building tools, our goal is to create the financial system of record for Dashers. We are early in this journey — launching and scaling zero-to-one products that redefine how Dashers interact with their money.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate, Strategy & Operations to join our Dasher Financial team. This role is about building the operations of a bank program at scale — a bank product that is already used by millions of Dashers each month.

Unlike traditional banks that feel slow and impersonal, our ambition is to build a financial product that is fast, intuitive, and genuinely supportive — one that helps Dashers not just hold money, but actively improve their financial health. To deliver on that promise, we need exceptional operators who can take tough operational problems, turn them into clear plans, and drive them to completion.

As an Associate, you will:

  • Own a core area of the Crimson banking program end to end — the metrics, the operating model, and the cross-functional partners who make it work
  • Turn ambiguous operational problems into structured plans, and drive them through Product, Engineering, Legal, and external partners
  • Build the monitoring and mechanisms that catch problems before users report them, rather than after
  • Manage external vendors and partners: hold them to their SLAs, escalate when they miss, and negotiate what we need

Disputes & Support 

This role owns the Crimson support and disputes experience — the systems, partners, and processes that determine whether a Dasher who has a problem gets it solved. You'll own dispute operations as we bring them in-house, Crimson support performance and tooling, and the complaint monitoring that tells us what's actually broken in the product.

Growth Ops

This role owns the top of the Crimson funnel: identity verification and onboarding, and the campaigns that bring non-Crimson Dashers and DoorDash consumers into the product. You'll own KYC health and vendor performance, reduce friction from application through first use, and drive acquisition.

Dasher Financial is an ambitious bet - building fintech products for the future of work. For someone with a strong foundation in problem solving who wants to grow into a future operator or general manager, this is a rare opportunity to learn by doing in a zero-to-one environment. 

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Analyze & problem-solve: Break down ambiguous problems, run analyses, and recommend solutions that improve adoption, retention, and trust.
  • Drive execution: Own and deliver discrete projects that move our key metrics (e.g., deposits, bill pay adoption, dispute resolution SLA).
  • Experiment & learn: Design and test hypotheses, measure impact, and help scale what works.
  • Collaborate: Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, and Legal to launch and improve initiatives.
  • Grow fast: Build the toolkit of a future operator/GM by working on zero-to-one fintech problems in a high-growth environment.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 2-3 years of experience and have succeeded in high-growth teams (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience)
  • You have exceptional problem-solving skills and back your decisions with data (comfortable pulling SQL or modeling in Excel)
  • You’re curious, driven, and comfortable with ambiguity
  • You want to learn fast and take ownership
  • You have a Bachelor’s Degree in a related field

You'll take new initiatives from early and messy to scaled and repeatable, then move on to the next highest-impact problem. Role Description

As the Senior Manager of Lifecycle Marketing, you will own Dropbox’s lifecycle marketing strategy across onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, expansion, cross-sell, and re-engagement. You will lead a team of lifecycle marketers and build a portfolio of programs that help customers discover value, expand their use of Dropbox, and deepen their relationship with our products over time.

You will set the lifecycle strategy and roadmap, determine where the team should invest, establish how programs are prioritized and measured, and stay close enough to the work to raise the quality of execution and unblock the highest-priority initiatives.

You will work closely with Product Growth, Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other marketing teams. Lifecycle Marketing will own customer communication strategy, channel planning, lifecycle program design, and marketing execution.

The Head of Lifecycle Marketing will define how those pieces connect across the customer lifecycle and build the operating model needed to move from individual campaigns toward scalable growth programs.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, growth marketing, customer engagement, or closely related disciplines, ideally in a SaaS, subscription, or product-led business.

jobs.title: Security GRC Analyst/Program Manager, Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

 

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Security Analyst / Program Manager to build and scale Bridge’s security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design the security governance, risk and compliance programs from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and tackle Bridge’s most important security risks quickly and pragmatically.
  • Adopt Stripe’s programs, controls and processes where it makes sense, and find custom approaches where it doesn’t.
  • Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure.
  • Ensure Bridge meets compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and Stripe’s security org to move fast without compromising safety.

Minimum Requirements

  • Have 8+ years of experience in Security GRC, ideally with time spent in fast-paced startup environments where you’ve built security practices from the ground up.
  • Have a startup mindset: you’re scrappy, pragmatic, and move quickly to solve the most critical problems.
  • You’re proficient with NIST CSF, OCC’s Cybersecurity Supervision Work Program and/or FFIEC IT Examination Handbook or other similar global frameworks. 
  • Proven prior experience with regulatory audits from Global auditors across Security domains.
  • Thrive in ambiguity and know how to ruthlessly prioritize.
  • Can balance security rigor with speed, especially in fast-moving environments.
  • Demonstrated history converting complex policy, audit, and regulatory mandates into actionable operational and engineering controls.
  • Broad technical depth across cloud architecture, identity management, appsec, data protection, and incident response operations.
  • A track record of evaluating control environments, uncovering underlying risks, and executing sensible, long-term solutions.
  • Strong program execution skills: crafting strategic roadmaps, setting milestones, navigating cross-team blockers, and driving remediation projects to completion.
  • A collaborative approach to partnering across engineering, product, compliance, legal, and audit teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Have experience building or scaling security programs through execution, either at a startup or in an embedded role.
  • Are excited about the potential of crypto and stablecoins to power global financial infrastructure (you don’t need deep prior knowledge—just curiosity and openness to learn).

Why This Role Matters

As a Field Enablement Manager supporting Datadog's EMEA Enterprise business, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our global enablement programs translate into local impact for some of our most strategic sellers

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー (Technical Account Manager)

Asanaのテクニカルアカウントマネジャー（Technical Account Manager: TAM）は、顧客が日々の業務において「明瞭さ（Clarity）」を見出し、Asanaを活用して成果を上げることを支援します。TAMはAsanaのエキスパートであり、顧客の成功に情熱を注ぐ生産性のプロフェッショナルです。顧客からの質問、機能リクエスト、インシデント報告に対応し、中長期的な視点でのAsana活用のためのベストプラクティスを提供します。また、Asana社内では顧客の声を製品開発に反映させるための代弁者となり、製品開発チームと対話します。TAMの成功指標は「顧客の成功」であり、顧客への深い共感（Empathy）を通じてそれを実現します。

AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。

【勤務地・働き方】

このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。

私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。

  • 関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。

  • 関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています（詳細は面接時にご案内します）。

なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。

【主な業務内容】

  • 顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供

  • エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。

  • Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。

  • 顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。

  • 顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理

  • 顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。

  • セールス、カスタマーサクセスマネージャ（CSM）と共同で利用パターンやエンゲージメント傾向からヘルススコアを監視し、リスクの早期発見や、利用拡大・再エンゲージメントの機会を特定する。

  • 各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。

  • 社内連携と製品へのフィードバック

  • 社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。

  • セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。

  • 顧客の声を代弁し、実際のユースケースや課題に基づいたフィードバックを行うことで、製品ロードマップへ影響を与える。

【応募資格】

  • 経験とドメイン知識

  • SaaS業界における、顧客対面型の技術的役割（TAM、ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタントなど）での5年以上の経験。

  • ワークフロー、自動化、ビジネスプロセス管理（BPM）など、業務プロセスに関わるSaaS・ソフトウェアを直接取り扱った経験。

  • ※インフラやセキュリティ領域専業ではなく、ビジネスロジックやアプリケーション層の課題解決に関わった経験を重視します。

  • 大規模なエンタープライズ顧客の複雑なステークホルダー管理を行い、プロジェクトを成功に導いた実績。

  • 技術的専門性

  • API、システム連携、認証プロトコル（SAML, SCIM）、および技術アーキテクチャについて、顧客と自信を持って議論できる技術的知見。

  • SaaSインフラ、セキュリティ基準、エンタープライズIT環境に関する広範な理解。

  • 顧客の技術的な課題や質問を素早く理解し、複雑な概念を噛み砕いて解決策を提示する能力。

  • コミュニケーションと言語能力

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, our People Partners contribute to organizational strategy and meaningfully impact business outcomes. We are looking for a People Partner to support key segments across our Go-To-Market (GTM) and Sales teams.  Reporting directly to the Director, GTM People Partners, you will work alongside executive leadership, facilitate strategy, and solve high-impact, real-world business challenges.

We’re moving fast, reinventing playbooks, and actively embracing the new era of AI and modern organizational dynamics. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a Strategic Thought Partner: Establish yourself as an indispensable, embedded partner to sales and GTM leaders by aligning talent priorities directly with business outcomes.
  • Drive Creative Problem-Solving: Acts with urgency, proactively diagnosing team, manager, and organizational needs, and recommends business aligned solutions. 
  • Execute Core Talent Programs: Drive continuous talent management, compensation/reward programs, and retention strategies designed to lower attrition in high-volume GTM environments.

  • Connect in Person: Travel roughly once per quarter for leadership offsites, business strategy meetings, and key team gatherings.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Within New Verticals, the Consumer Strategy & Operations team focuses on building consumer growth levers through many different outlets. The pricing, fee, and savings systems we build are a big part of why customers choose DoorDash and stay. We're building toward a future where every customer feels DoorDash is worth it on every order. Getting there takes sharp, quantitative thinking about how we price and where we invest.

You’ll work closely with Finance, Analytics, and Product in forecasting consumer and financial impacts, building pricing models, design A/B tests, and launching new fee structures. It's a high-visibility seat at the intersection of strategy, operations, and finance - your analyses will inform decisions that reach millions of customers. 

The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. jobs.description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. jobs.title: Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Team/Role Overview

The GFCO Programs team is the end-to-end DRI for the financial crimes compliance operations experience and automation across Coinbase's global product and entity footprint. We design, govern, and continuously improve compliance operations through AI-first principles, ensuring regulatory soundness, protecting Coinbase, and delivering a better experience for our customers.

We partner deeply with Central Compliance, Compliance Technology, Engineering & Architecture (EAA), GFCO Operations, Analytics, Workforce Management (WFM), Financial Crimes Data Intelligence (FCDI), and Legal to translate regulatory obligations and operational opportunities into scalable, durable programs across all compliance workstreams, products, and jurisdictions — including Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Screening, and Complaints.

As a Senior Strategic Program Lead, GFCO (L5), you will serve as a independent program owner within GFCO Programs — owning one or more complex compliance program verticals end-to-end. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, drive alignment with Director+ stakeholders, and lead programs that span several cross-functional teams, including external parties. You will act as a thought partner to GFCO leadership and be the connective tissue between Compliance Technology, EAA, Operations, WFM, and Central Compliance.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end program strategy, planning, and execution for one or more complex GFCO compliance program areas (e.g., SAM/CAR automation, EDD volume reduction, Complaints, Operations, New Jurisdictions & Launches)
  • Develop and drive program charters, roadmaps, and governance frameworks for long-tail, multi-constraint programs, including those with external regulatory commitments
  • Lead cross-functional delivery across XFN teams (Compliance Tech, EAA, Ops, WFM, Legal, Analytics) and drive alignment at the Director+ level
  • Translate regulatory obligations, operational gaps, and model performance signals into actionable, prioritized program strategies using an Eliminate → Optimize → Automate framework
  • Support launch readiness for new products, jurisdictions, and entity expansions, ensuring AML obligation mapping, tooling updates, procedural guidance, volume sizing, and training content are completed before go-live
  • Proactively identify and resolve program risks, manage competing priorities with transparent trade-off recommendations to GFCO leadership, and ensure no surprises at regulatory examinations
  • Drive WFM-vetted cost savings projections across automation and operational efficiency initiatives, and maintain accountability for reporting only confirmed actuals
  • Own intake discipline for your program area — ensuring all automation requests, tooling changes, and resource asks enter through formal intake channels with documented requirements and testing plans
  • Author and maintain high-quality strategy and decision documents (P/PSs, RAPIDs, charters) that inform Director/VP-level decision-making
  • Manage the feedback loop between automation outputs, QC findings, alert productivity data, and investigator feedback, driving continuous improvement in both the automation model and upstream alerting systems
  • Lead Code Yellow-equivalent responses within GFCO (e.g., major lookback events, regulatory deadline responses, Sev2 volume surges)

 

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of program or project management experience, with 3+ years in financial crimes compliance, AML, BSA/AML operations, or a related regulatory domain
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in a regulated environment with minimal guidance
  • Deep understanding of AML/CFT program operations, including SAM/TMS, EDD, Screening, and SAR filing workflows, and the technology landscape that supports them (e.g., TMS, CMS)

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Elastic is expanding the Ecosystem Architects team focused on the most consequential AI providers in the AI Ecosystem — OpenAI and Anthropic. We are looking for a builder, an architect who will own the technical strategy and relationships with both.

In this hands-on individual contributor role you'd be driving the co-build strategy through deeper integrations with both ecosystems, influencing Elastic Product strategy, building the prototypes, and shaping the GTM content that would help customers bring frontier intelligence to unstructured data.

BUILDING

  • Working with Elastic's Security and Observability product teams to drive integration patterns and showcases that demonstrate how frontier AI enhances Elastic's capabilities.
  • Influencing Elastic's product roadmap with the technical signal you gather inside both ecosystems — what partner teams are building, what customers are asking for, and where the gaps are.

 

LEADING

  • Owning the technical and strategic relationships with partner-facing counterparts at OpenAI and Anthropic.

  • Keeping Elastic's internal teams — product, engineering, field, and alliances — connected to what's happening inside both partner ecosystems, and vice versa.

EVANGELIZING

  • Working with Elastic marketing teams to translate integrations into enablement that the field can use and customers can act on.

  • Proven experience owning technical relationships with strategic AI or platform partners — serving as the named technical point of contact.

jobs.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT THE ROLE Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You’ll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs. You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer’s needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams’ roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. This role is focused on Commercial and Mid-Market customers, supporting high-growth companies with standardized financial workflows, core ERP integrations, and repeatable implementation patterns that drive fast time-to-value. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Act as a technical advisor to customers and Ramp’s internal teams while supporting high-value implementations and expansion opportunities by guiding integration, configuration, and system design - Partner with Customer Activation and Account Management teams to assess customer requirements and propose scalable solutions; particularly involving ERP, HRIS, and API integrations - Collaborate with onboarding specialists and implementation leads to support technical workstreams (not run them), ensuring faster time-to-value and customer success - Work with customers to problem-solve technical hurdles and propose effective product implementations for each customer with a deep understanding of the full range of integration and configuration options - Participate in technical discovery to understand customer systems and workflows, and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture. SAP S/4HANA or Sage Intacct expertise highly preferred. - Comfort working with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture and being able to explain those concepts to finance and operations stakeholders - Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value, guide customers toward scalable approaches, and diplomatically steer conversations when requests are misaligned with best practices or product capabilities - Collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering - Exceptional organization and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action and a high level of ownership

About the Role:

Gusto is seeking a Manager for our Health Insurance Benefits Advising team who is passionate about providing small business owners and their employees with the best customer experience and expert benefits advice. You will lead a licensed benefits advisor organization by empowering and enabling your individual contributors to deliver a best in class customer experience effectively in a fast paced environment. You’ll be a great fit if you also have experience in effectively managing OKR/team initiatives while also leading a high performing team.

About the Team:

The Health Insurance Benefits Advising team at Gusto is focused on understanding the health insurance needs of small businesses, and consulting on solutions to help their employees thrive. The Benefits Advising leader will empower a team in Gusto’s licensed advising renewal organization, ensuring our customers offer the best health insurance and benefits offerings for their employees. This role will balance both customer impact and operational excellence: you’ll be responsible for driving customer retention, expansion, and exceptional customer experience at scale.

Your team will support small business owners in accessing the best health insurance and holistic benefits offerings - including ancillary coverage, tax-advantaged accounts, and retirement plans like 401(k). Much of this work is centered around small group health insurance, including fully insured and level-funded plans, where tailored guidance is essential for customer success.

You’ll directly empower a team of 10-15 licensed advisors and specialists, guiding them through renewal cycles and enabling them to serve as trusted advisors to our customers.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Empower & Coach to Operational Excellence: Provide regular coaching and performance management (via 1:1s and monthly reviews) focused on technical mastery, customer-centricity, and hitting KPIs.
  • Drive retention and revenue growth: Deliver on retention targets by ensuring tailored, high-quality renewal experiences through a customer’s renewal and ongoing benefits experience. 
  • Evolve the customer experience: Use customer feedback and data to identify and drive improved processes and deliver more holistic, outcomes-focused advising. Act as project manager for large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that result in better outcomes for our customers

New Verticals is an exciting team at DoorDash that is building and scaling new ways to delight our customers beyond restaurant delivery.

Our Central Operations team, part of New Verticals Strategy & Operations, is re-inventing how consumers shop grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail by making every store’s digital shelf match the physical shelf. We do this by onboarding new data sources that improve selection coverage, price accuracy, inventory accuracy, and the location data that helps Dashers find the store and the item. When these get better, consumers see what they want at the right price and receive it with fewer substitutions and refunds, Dashers shop and navigate faster, and merchants sell more. You will partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to build AI-enabled tooling, launch operational processes at scale, own metrics, and pull operational and product levers across our Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol and Retail businesses.

About the Role

We are looking to hire a Manager to own how we onboard new data sources, external and internal, onto our ecosystem. Externally, you will bring on inventory and syndicated data providers, CPG branded data, in-store robotics companies, and other software and technology partners. Internally, you will find new ways to leverage the data we already have. Together, these sources align the physical inventory of brick-and-mortar stores with the digital inventory. You will also explore how these assets could grow into an inventory-as-a-service solution. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You will sit in the Central Operations group within our New Verticals Strategy & Operations organization and report into a Senior Manager. You will manage a team of two.

  • Own the economics. You’ll define the commercial and business metrics that show when a source works and when it doesn’t, and weigh the lift against the cost to make clear scale, iterate, or stop decisions.
  • Lead. You’ll partner with Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Commercial teams to integrate sources and drive measurable impact.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 6-8+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, supply chain, operations, strategy, business development, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience), ideally with data

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. jobs.description:
Head of Enterprise GTM Strategy & Operations

Reports to VP, Enterprise Sales  · SF or NY

Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Sales, this role owns both halves of Scale AI’s enterprise revenue engine: the strategy that determines where we play and how we win, and the operating system - people, process, and systems - that makes that strategy executable, measurable, and repeatable.

On the strategy side, you set the analytical foundation for enterprise growth: segment and account prioritization, coverage and territory design, pricing and packaging inputs, and the diagnostic work that explains why the funnel behaves the way it does. On the operations side, you own the RevOps stack, forecasting, compensation design, sales enablement, and the operating cadences that convert strategy into predictable quarterly execution. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a segmentation model from a blank page and running a Monday morning pipeline review.

You will lead an established team, with the Head of Sales Enablement and the RevOps Manager as direct reports. Your first job is to raise the ceiling on what that team delivers: sharper analysis, tighter operating rhythm, and enablement that measurably shortens ramp and lifts win rates.

This is a senior, highly visible role partnering with Enterprise Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Product, and Solutions Engineering, with regular exposure to the executive team and board materials.

STRATEGY

  • Define which segments, industries, and accounts Scale prioritizes, and build the analytical case behind those choices
  • Build and maintain the market sizing, segmentation, and account-tiering models that drive coverage decisions and investment trade-offs
  • Lead hypothesis-driven analyses of the enterprise funnel - win/loss patterns, conversion drivers, deal economics, coverage gaps - and translate findings into specific changes to how we sell
  • Partner with Finance and Product on pricing, packaging, and deal-structure strategy for enterprise agreements
  • Own the route-to-market point of view: direct vs. partner, land-and-expand mechanics, and where new capacity or capability is needed
  • Build the strategic narrative and executive materials behind annual planning, board reporting, and major GTM investment decisions
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, bringing an independent, well-argued view on how accounts should be covered and engaged

OPERATIONS & ENABLEMENT

  • Own and evolve the enterprise GTM operating model: account engagement strategy, funnel design, and sales execution standards
  • Direct the RevOps systems stack (CRM, forecasting, reporting, planning tools) through the RevOps Manager, and hold the bar on data integrity and operational discipline
  • Define and operationalize core GTM metrics across pipeline health, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity, with executive dashboards to match
  • Run the sales operating cadence: pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and performance reviews
  • Set the enablement agenda with the Head of Sales Enablement - onboarding and ramp, ongoing skill development, and the playbooks and certification that turn GTM strategy into consistent field execution
  • Tie enablement investment to outcomes, measuring impact on ramp time, win rate, and deal quality rather than activity or completion
  • Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance on enterprise compensation plan design, quota governance, and attainment reporting
  • Lead annual and quarterly planning, including territory design, capacity modeling, headcount planning, and quota setting
  • Act as the connective tissue across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Solutions Engineering for enterprise GTM planning and execution

LEADERSHIP

  • Lead, develop, and retain an established team spanning sales enablement and revenue operations
  • Set clear priorities and standards for a team whose work is consumed by the entire enterprise sales organization
  • Grow the function as the enterprise business scales, making the call on where added capacity creates the most leverage

  • Experience managing and developing a team, including managing other managers or senior functional leads
  • Proven ability to frame an ambiguous question, build the analytical approach, and drive to a defensible recommendation on incom

We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. This is a highly customer-facing role at the intersection of engineering, solution architecture, agentic AI, and customer delivery. You will work directly with stakeholders and own the technical discovery for our ongoing opportunities end to end. Once a deal is qualified, you scope, build, embed with the client, and build it yourself, code that holds up against real tax and jurisdiction data, not a prototype you clean up later. What you ship only counts once the client is paying for it, it's live, and it's measurably cutting the manual work they used to do by hand, hours saved, tickets deflected, risk reduced.   • Clear the Blockers: Diagnose and fix the data issues, jurisdiction mapping, tax ID reconciliation, that stand between a client and production.
  • Bridge the Gap: Keep technical teams and business stakeholders aligned as requirements evolve mid-engagement, so scope changes don't blindside either side.
  • Own the Handoff: Deliver the build and a runbook Client Success runs solo without the need to loop back the FDE.
  • Close the Loop: Feed structured signal from both the sales motion and the build motion back into product and go-to-market strategy, including infrastructure gaps.
  • Create Implementation Playbooks: solution patterns, demo flows, and deployment documentation that make future deployments faster.

  • Demonstrated 5+ years of hands-on experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, AI Engineer, Implementation Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar.

    • Agentic workflows beyond prototypes: MCP or function-calling patterns, evaluation and reliability practices
  • Deep technical discovery skills with the ability to navigate a high degree of ambiguity

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Brand & Content
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we work to achieve that mission, our cross functional Tech Operations and Programs team helps enable Tech organizations to execute and deliver on high impact programs and initiatives. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will decide what the engineering world knows about Airbnb.

  • Our engineers solve hard problems at scale across infrastructure, data, and applied AI — and they write about that work well. Almost none of the engineers we'd most like to hire have ever seen it.
  • You'll change that, and the change is measurable. A year in, senior candidates should arrive already able to describe our technical work accurately, because they found it before we found them. Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain. And the strongest engineers in the market should have a reason to choose us that has nothing to do with the offer.
  • That is a rare kind of impact for this discipline. Most tech brand roles are asked to manufacture credibility that isn't there. Here the engineering is genuinely strong and already documented — the gap is that it doesn't travel. You'd be building the function that closes it, with real autonomy, very little inherited process, and direct access to engineering leaders and our CTO.

A Typical Day:

  • Own the editorial engine. Run the Airbnb Tech Blog end to end: sourcing topics from teams, coaching engineer-authors, editing to a high bar, and moving posts through legal, security and comms review without letting them stall. Set and hold a publishing rhythm the org can rely on.
  • Find the cross-team narratives. Our biggest gap is that individually strong posts never add up to a story. You'll work across orgs to identify the themes that connect work from multiple teams, and publish them as connected sets — while each domain keeps publishing in depth for its own specialists.
  • Build our voices. Help our engineers and technical leaders develop genuine public presence: bylines, talks, speaker coaching, and a pipeline of new voices. This includes partnering closely with our CTO to establish his public technical presence.
  • Own distribution. Establish our canonical home on an Airbnb-owned domain, stand up the surfaces we're missing including video, and decide what our social channels are for. Publishing well and distributing poorly is the pattern we're here to break.
  • Run our external presence. Set conference and event strategy — where we speak, where we sponsor, where we skip — and manage what we host ourselves. Own our academic collaborations and technical media relationships, and the budget and vendors behind all of it.
  • Steward our open source presence. Make sure what Airbnb claims publicly is accurate and actually maintained, and that the projects carrying our name reflect how we want to be seen.
  • Prove it works. Partner with Talent Acquisition to connect this work to hiring outcomes — inbound share of the senior pipeline, offer acceptance at staff level and above in ML and infrastructure — and be honest about what is and isn't attributable.

Your Expertise:

  • Substantial experience in technical content, developer relations, engineering communications or technical editorial — including time spent working directly with engineers, not adjacent to them.
  • Technical fluency. You don't need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in a systems design conversation, read a design doc, and judge whether a draft post says anything real. Credibility with staff engineers is the difference between this role working and not working.
  • Editorial judgment and hands-on craft. You can edit an engineer's draft into something sharper without flattening their voice, and you know the difference between a post that teaches something and one that announces something.
  • Influence without authority. Nothing you need is owned by you. You've built systems and incentives that got busy senior people to produce, rather than relying on persistence.
  • Program discipline. You've owned events, budgets and vendors end to end, and you're comfortable with the unglamorous half of the job.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. As a Sr. Manager of Machine Learning, you will lead teams that fuse on-device computer vision with IMU, GPS, and vehicle diagnostic data to detect, interpret, and surface actionable safety events and continuous risk signals. 

You’ll own the model lifecycle across edge and cloud – data curation, training, evaluation (including shadow/online experiments), deployment, monitoring, and iteration—and develop the core AI platform that powers these capabilities at fleet scale.   • 3-5 years of experience in channel sales
  • 3+ years experience working in the SaaS or telecom industry
  • Fluency in Dutch is required
  • Creative and passionate about partnering; exceptional ability to develop relationships
  • Engaged personality, polished verbal and written communication skills and meticulous attention to detail
  • “Hunter” mindset with the ability to generate partner referral opportunities while also developing longer term partner relationships
  • Highly organized self-starter who runs toward opportunities
  • Proficient with web-based demo software and tools
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment
  • Willingness to travel (70%) as needed 

Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder. At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. Gusto is looking for an experienced Senior Data Science Leader to empower our Sales Data team, the team that powers the insights, forecasting, and measurement infrastructure behind how we acquire, expand, and retain our revenue base.

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Square is building a world-class, high-accountability field sales organization — and we’re looking for a leader based in LA who is both a coach and a builder. You lead from the front, developing your team through active engagement — not from the sidelines.

You will be the driving force behind a disciplined, insight-led sales motion that blends in-person selling with proactive outbound strategy. Your leadership will elevate both the quality and velocity of revenue while shaping a culture rooted in excellence, ownership, and growth.

If you are a hands-on leader with deep product expertise, strong competitive instincts, and a track record of raising the bar for sellers — this is your next move.

Lead with expertise in the field

  • Develop Territory Account Executives through active, in-market coaching — from sourcing and opening conversations to consultative discovery, competitive positioning, and closing with clarity.

Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are domain experts aligned to Stripe’s solutions and the customer buying centers they serve. We combine deep product and industry expertise with an understanding of our customers’ most complex business and technical challenges.

The SSA team partners with specialist sellers and the broader pre-sales organization to shape strategic opportunities, develop pipeline, improve revenue attainment, and turn Stripe’s product capabilities into measurable customer outcomes. We also bring field insights to Product and Engineering, helping influence Stripe’s roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

What you'll do

As Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture for Revenue in the Americas, you will lead the regional strategy, execution, and growth of the SSA organization supporting Stripe’s Revenue Suite. You will define how Stripe engages customers around billing, monetization, and revenue management—from initial business and technical discovery through solution design, adoption, value realization, and expansion.

You will build and develop a high-performing team of specialist architects and create the operating model, playbooks, and cross-functional partnerships needed to scale the organization. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering, you will help customers modernize their revenue infrastructure while accelerating adoption and growth for Stripe’s Revenue Suite across the United States, Canada, and Latin America.

This is an opportunity to shape a growing regional function at an important point in Stripe’s expansion beyond payments. You will connect deep technical expertise to customer value and commercial outcomes while ensuring that the needs of AMER customers influence Stripe’s global product and go-to-market direction.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations - Dasher Financial
jobs.location: Austin, TX; Washington D.C.; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Chicago, IL
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Dasher & Logistics team supports the millions of Dashers who power DoorDash's marketplace. Dasher Financial is our bet that the financial system serving gig workers should be built by the platform they already work on. From instant access to earnings, to bill pay and savings, to credit-building tools, our goal is to become the financial home for Dashers. Our banking product serves 2M+ monthly active Dashers, and the business has more than doubled in the past year.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager to run our banking business, and to grow into the GM of it. This is a business already at scale: millions of users, it generates real revenue, and it runs on a regulated program with a sponsor bank and processor partners. But the business is also early enough that the decisions you make will help determine what this becomes.

The first twelve months are about making the business stronger on every axis at once: growing the user base and the revenue levers that already work, taking down the cost to serve, and pulling more of the banking operation under our own control. These three pull against each other, and deciding how to trade them off against the P&L is the job.

You'll also be the face of this business outside the company. Our processor, program manager, and sponsor bank determine what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll own those relationships, hold partners to what they committed to, and sit at the table when we negotiate the next set of terms. This is a commercial role as much as an operational one.

And you'll lead the team that runs it, hiring and developing operators who own their surfaces while staying hands-on yourself. At this stage the person running the business is still personally in the data, in the partner rooms, and in the details of how the machine actually works.

You will:

  • Own the P&L - user growth, revenue per user, and cost to serve
  • Build the operating model for a regulated financial product: service levels, vendor accountability, escalation paths, and the controls that keep the program healthy
  • Own our external partnerships end to end and represent the business in negotiations
  • Find the next revenue levers in a business that already has scale, and make the case for what we should invest in
  • Develop and lead a team of operators, and build the bench that lets the business grow faster than headcount
  • Represent the business to DoorDash leadership as its owner

This seat is where that bet becomes a real business: a P&L you own, partners you negotiate with, and an operation you get to build. For someone who wants to run a company one day, it's the closest thing to doing it with a scaled platform behind you.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Run a business: own the P&L for a banking product millions of Dashers already use
  • Build the machine: design the operating model for a regulated financial product, and decide what we bring in-house, what we rent, and in what order.
  • Own external relationships: represent DoorDash with our sponsor bank and fintech partners
  • Find the next lever: identify where the next tranche of growth and revenue comes from in a business that already has scale, and make the case for the investment.
  • Lead people: develop operators who own their surfaces outright and build a team that grows the business faster than headcount
  • Grow into the GM seat: do the full job - strategy, P&L, operations, partners, and people - in a business early enough that your decisions still set its direction

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 8+ years of experience, including time running something with real operational stakes - a business line, a large operational surface, or a P&L.
  • You take a vague, consequential problem and structure it yourself. 
  • You use data to make decisions, but you’re also comfortable taking a stance before the data proves you right.
  • You have commercial instincts. You've negotiated, or made a call where the economics mattered as much as the operations
  • You take real ownership of outcomes - you make the calls and are accountable for how they turn out, not just for supporting the work. And you

jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Every year, millions of guests and Hosts across EMEA and LATAM reach out to us at moments that matter, a booking that fell through, a stay that didn't go to plan, a question that needs a clear answer in their own language. How we show up in those moments decides whether they come back.

We're looking for a senior operations leader to own that outcome. You'll lead a network of outsourced BPO partners delivering customer support across one of Airbnb's most complex regions, and you'll be accountable for the quality our community actually experiences, measured above all by NPS.

This is a performance leadership role, not an administrative one. You'll build the frameworks, insight loops and performance culture that genuinely move partner performance, and you'll lead a team of Partner Operations Managers who make that happen across every language, market and site.

  • Deep experience managing outsourced BPO partners and vendor relationships across multiple locations, ideally spanning EMEA, LATAM or another complex multi-region remit

  • Strong people leadership, including leading managers or senior individual contributors
  • Comfort operating across multiple markets and languages in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

Lead vendor delivery and performance

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - Public Sector
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations — fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders — run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably. 

We're looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology — from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for. 

This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes — helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve.
  • You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker.
  • You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined — you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Own public sector positioning and messaging: Develop and evolve Samsara's core narrative for government buyers across federal, state, local, and education segments — grounded in mission outcomes rather than generic product benefits
  • Build Samsara's federal go-to-market foundation: Partner cross-functionally to define how Samsara approaches the federal market, including messaging and enablement that reflect our compliance roadmap as it evolves
  • Translate compliance into a sales advantage: Understand the FedRAMP authorization process and impact levels — deeply enough to explain it clearly to sales teams and prospects, and to inform internal conversations about authorization strategy and timing
  • Drive product and platform launches for public sector: Localize Samsara's launches for a government audience, ensuring messaging reflects agency use cases, procurement realities, and compliance considerations
  • Enable sales and channel teams: Build battlecards, objection-handling guides, RFP/RFI response content, and compliance-focused sales collateral that helps account teams and channel partners win competitive government deals

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom around the world, and we couldn’t do this without hiring the best people. We’re a group of hard-working overachievers who are deeply focused on building the future of finance and Web3 for our users across the globe, whether they’re trading, storing, staking or using crypto. Know those people who always lead the group project? That’s us.

There are a few things we look for across all hires we make at Coinbase, regardless of role or team. First, we look for candidates who will thrive in a culture like ours, where we default to trust, embrace feedback, and disrupt ourselves. Second, we expect all employees to commit to our mission-focused approach to our work. Finally, we seek people who are excited to learn about and live crypto, because those are the folks who enjoy the intense moments in our sprint and recharge work culture. We’re a remote-first company looking to hire the absolute best talent all over the world.

Ready to #LiveCrypto? Who you are:

  • You’ve got positive energy. You’re optimistic about the future and determined to get there. 
  • You’re never tired of learning. You want to be a pro in bleeding edge tech like DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, and Web 3.0. 
  • You appreciate direct communication. You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other. You’re cool with candid feedback and see every setback as an opportunity to grow.
  • You can pivot on the fly. Crypto is constantly evolving, so our priorities do, too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you. You’re not looking for a boring job.
  • You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines. Owning a problem doesn’t scare you, but rather empowers you to take 100% responsibility for achieving our mission.
  • You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal.

 

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):

  • Promote customer retention, growth and satisfaction by maintaining positive and long-term customer relationships, including proactively reaching out to customers based on user data, following-up on communications or providing additional education for our highest value customers.
  • You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and  collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.

  • Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.
  • Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products th

About the Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Senior Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
  • Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
  • Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
  • Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
  • Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
  • International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As a Senior Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Senior Analyst roles share a common foundation: owning complex analytical problems end to end, translating data into business strategy, and influencing decisions across technical and non-technical teams.

You will operate with autonomy to own the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision. You bring exceptional analytical rigor, deep domain expertise, and the ability to translate complex regulatory, economic, and machine learning insights into actionable business strategies. You thrive in ambiguity, balance growth with resilience, and are comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels to influence stakeholders across the organization.

What You Will Do
